reviews.Text: We watched a video on YouTube about this company and how they make the salt. They explained just how high quality it is and what it's used for. Despite eating in fine restaurants across the globe, we never thought of using finishing salt on our own cooking - until finding this. Now there is a bamboo salt holder on the counter next to the stove. Steak, vegetables, eggs - it all gets a pinch (or more) of the finishing salt just prior to serving - and it is fantastic. One thing to note about this particular finishing salt is the high quality. If you find the video I mentioned, you'll see they put a lot of thought and effort into finding just the right location for the perfect sea water intake to make the salt. It really shows when compared to other similar salts. We purchased a different brand from a local high-end cooking store and the quality didn't come close to this from Jacobson. We replaced our Celtic salt and pink salts several years ago as a result of them testing high lead and a couple of other metals. Now we only use Jacobson‘s Oregon sourced salt, and have recently added back Maldon’s green box flake salt as well as it is slightly more cost-effective. Jacobson‘s kosher salt is not too large (the one that sold in the canister) and works quite well in our salt grinder. This flake salt is perfect for grilled meats.
